text: No, there is no evidence that the tree cover on this property changed in 2026. The latest available observations from Hansen GFC are from 2025, and no changes are recorded in the dataset for that year or earlier within the analyzed period. The JRC 2020 reference confirms the presence of 43.3 hectares of forest (11.55% of the asset) as of 2020, but no newer corroborating data is available to confirm changes in 2026.
